about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Muc Rang Muoi Vietnamese Salt and Chilli Squid
recipes.summary: Tender squid tossed in a hot pan with garlic, chilli and salt, crisp-edged and served with lime and rice.

items: 600g squid tubes, scored and cut into pieces

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Pat the squid dry and toss with the cornflour.
Fry in 3 tbsp oil in a very hot pan for 2 minutes, in 2 batches, until golden and curled. Lift out.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and chillies for 30 seconds, return the squid with the salt, sugar and spring onions and toss for 30 seconds.
Serve with the lime and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the squid until opaque and firm, at least 63°C; do not overcook or it turns rubbery. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sate Lilit Balinese Fish Skewers
recipes.summary: Minced fish with coconut, lime leaf and spice paste wrapped around lemongrass sticks and grilled.

items: 600g firm white fish fillets, finely minced

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Mix the fish with the coconut, shallots, garlic, ginger, chillies, lime juice, sugar and salt, kneading for 2 minutes until sticky.
Mould a heaped spoonful around each lemongrass stalk, pressing firmly.
Brush with the oil and grill over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning, until golden and opaque, then serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bebek Goreng Indonesian Crispy Fried Duck
recipes.summary: Duck legs simmered in spiced coconut water, then fried until the skin crackles, served with sambal and rice.
steps: Put the duck, coconut water, shallots, garlic, coriander, turmeric, salt and bay in a pot, cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes until the duck is very tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Lift out the duck and pat dry thoroughly.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until the skin is deep golden and crisp.
Serve with the sambal and rice.
notes: Food safety: duck must reach at least 75°C; long simmering takes it well past that. Keep hot oil away from water. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Empal Gepuk Javanese Sweet Fried Beef
recipes.summary: Beef simmered in palm sugar, coriander and galangal, flattened, then fried until crisp-edged and sweet.

items: 700g beef shin, cut into large pieces

steps: Put the beef, water, shallots, garlic, coriander, galangal, sugar, soy sauce and salt in a pot, cover and simmer for 80 minutes until tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Lift out the beef, drain, and press flat with the back of a heavy pan.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until browned and crisp at the edges.
Slice and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: beef must reach at least 71°C and be tender before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sambal Sotong Malaysian Squid in Sambal
recipes.summary: Squid rings tossed in a fiery sweet-sour chilli sambal and served with rice.
steps: Blend the chillies, shallots and garlic into a paste.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil rises, then add the tomatoes, tamarind, sugar and salt and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the squid and cook for 2 minutes only, until opaque and curled, then serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the squid until opaque and firm, at least 63°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Daing na Isda Garlic Vinegar Fried Fish
recipes.summary: Fish fillets marinated in vinegar, garlic and pepper then fried until crisp, served with garlic rice.
steps: Marinate the fish in the cane vinegar, half the garlic, pepper and salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the fish in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp and opaque.
Fry the remaining garlic in the last tbsp of oil until golden and stir through the rice.
Serve the fish with the garlic rice, tomato and white vinegar for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tokwa't Baboy Filipino Tofu and Pork
recipes.summary: Fried tofu and tender pork tossed in a sharp soy, vinegar and onion dressing, served with rice.
steps: Simmer the pork in the water until tender, about 25 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides, then lift out.
Fry the pork in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until browned.
Mix the vinegar, soy sauce, onions, chillies and pepper, toss through the tofu and pork, and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C; simmered until tender it will. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ayam Goreng Kalasan Javanese Sweet Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken simmered in coconut water and palm sugar, then fried until golden, a Yogyakarta classic.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the coconut water, shallots, garlic, coriander, turmeric, sugar, bay and salt for 35 minutes until tender and the liquid has nearly gone.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Drain the chicken, reserving any remaining paste.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Serve with the rice and the reserved paste.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Keep hot oil away from water. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ga Nuong Sa Vietnamese Lemongrass Grilled Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs marinated in lemongrass, garlic and fish sauce, grilled until sticky, served with rice and pickles.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, honey and oil, and coat the chicken.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Toss the carrot with the vinegar for quick pickles.
Grill the chicken over medium-high heat for 8 minutes each side, until charred in spots and cooked through.
Slice and serve with the rice, cucumber and pickles.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Singapore Black Pepper Prawns
recipes.summary: Prawns tossed in a hot buttery sauce with cracked black pepper, garlic and oyster sauce.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Heat the oil and butter in a wok over high heat, add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Add the garlic and pepper for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Scatter with the spring onions and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sai Oua Lao Herb Pork Patties
recipes.summary: Lao herb sausage mixture shaped into patties with lemongrass, galangal and chilli, served with sticky rice.
steps: Mix the pork with the lemongrass, galangal, garlic, chillies, shallots, fish sauce and dill, kneading for 2 minutes until sticky.
Steam the rice, soaked beforehand, for 25 minutes until tender and sticky.
Shape into 8 flat patties.
Pan-fry in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve with the sticky rice and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must be cooked through to at least 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mok Pa Lao Steamed Fish Parcels
recipes.summary: Fish mixed with dill, lemongrass and coconut cream, steamed in parcels until soft and set.
steps: Mix the fish with the coconut cream, dill, lemongrass, spring onions, chillies, fish sauce and rice flour.
Steam the rice, soaked beforehand, for 25 minutes until tender and sticky.
Divide the mixture among 4 squares of baking paper, fold into sealed parcels and steam over boiling water for 18 minutes until set.
Open the parcels and serve with the sticky rice and lettuce.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until set and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kahuku Style Garlic Prawns with Rice and Mac Salad
recipes.summary: Shell-on prawns sautéed in lots of garlic butter with lemon, served with rice and macaroni salad.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Toss the macaroni with the mayonnaise and a pinch of salt.
Toss the prawns with the cornflour, paprika and salt, and fry in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes until pink and crisp.
Add the butter and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant, then finish with the lemon juice.
Serve with the rice and macaroni.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C. Contains shellfish, egg and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Grilled Snapper with Pepper Sauce
recipes.summary: Whole snapper rubbed with ginger and chilli, grilled until crisp, with a fresh tomato and pepper sauce.

items: 2 whole snapper, about 600g each, scaled and gutted

steps: Slash the fish on both sides and rub with the ginger, garlic, chilli powder, salt and 1 tbsp oil.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Grill or roast the fish at 220C for 22 minutes, turning once, until the skin is crisp and the flesh opaque.
Blend the tomatoes, chillies and onion, then simmer in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until thick.
Serve the fish with the sauce and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
